name: Cable Triceps Kickback
instructions: Set a pulley low, hinge forward with a flat back, and hold the handle with your upper arm parallel to your torso and your elbow bent.
Extend your elbow until your arm is straight behind you.
Pause and squeeze your triceps, then return slowly.
Keep your upper arm still and complete all reps before switching sides.
image_prompt_scene: Hinged forward with the upper arm parallel to the torso and the elbow bent holding the handle.
